subtopic: Pooled Investing and Portfolio Company Management
source_evidence: the adviser pools together the money invested in the fund by all the investors and uses that money to make investments on behalf of the fund; engage actively in the management and direction of the company or business in order to increase its value
answer: A private equity fund pools money from its investors and uses it to invest on their behalf. A common strategy is to take a controlling interest in a company, then actively manage and guide that portfolio company with the aim of increasing its value. Some private equity funds instead specialize in minority investments in fast-growing companies or startups.
